name: 横扫
description: 对相邻预告格内的所有敌方目标造成等同攻击力的伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source=context.piece,plan=battle.extensions.adventureWorld.plans[0]; if(!plan||plan.sourceId!==source.instanceId||plan.kind!=='attack'||source.x!==plan.origin.x||source.y!==plan.origin.y)return {success:false,message:'预告计划已失效'}; for(var i=0;i<plan.cells.length;i++){var cell=plan.cells[i],target=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.ownerPlayerId!==source.ownerPlayerId&&p.x===cell.x&&p.y===cell.y;});if(target)dealDamage(source,target,source.attack,'physical',battle,context.skill.id);}return {success:true,message:source.name+'执行横扫'}; }
